name: @dsh-external/dsh-mcskin-studio
description: Skin Studio panel + agent tools for drawing and reviewing Minecraft skins with the mcskin-artist skill.

description.en: Run mcskin-artist lint scoring and multi-view/multi-pose 3D review renders from the settings panel, and give the agent skin_lint / skin_render tools.
description.zh: 在设置面板里跑 mcskin-artist 的质量评分与多视角多姿态渲染审查，并为 agent 提供 skin_lint / skin_render 工具。
